run.resumeBody_one: {{count}} attempt was not run. Resuming may spend up to {{cost}} in total.
run.resumeBody_other: {{count}} attempts were not run. Resuming may spend up to {{cost}} in total.

empty.title: No evals yet
empty.body: An eval gives an agent file, a skill, a rule or CLAUDE.md a few prompts and checks the tool calls Claude makes, so you can tell whether a change makes it follow its instructions better or worse.

notGit.title: This project is not a git repository
notGit.body: An eval pins a commit and runs each sample on it. Turn the folder into a git repository and make a first commit to use evals.

noCommit.title: No commit to pin yet
noCommit.body: An eval pins a commit and runs each sample on it. Make a first commit in this repository to use evals.

invalid.title: This file cannot run
invalid.body: Claudio lists a file it cannot read, with the reason, and never runs it. Fix it in the repository, or remove it here.

call.tool: Tool or tools, e.g. Edit, MultiEdit

hint.called: A call happens, as many times as asked
hint.before: A call comes before another one
hint.after: A call comes after another one
hint.file: A file exists or holds something
hint.touched: A path changed, or did not
hint.command: A command run in the lane exits as expected
hint.judged: A model checks a statement against what happened

expect.strict: Nothing may come between the steps
expect.touchedLabel: Whether the path must be touched
expect.runHint: Runs on this machine, in the lane, once you accept the file
expect.statementHint: What a judge model must find true, for example “Explains why it chose X over Y before editing”. The judge sees only the calls and the final answer.

editor.deleteBody: The file is removed from the repository's folder. The runs already made stay in the history.
editor.jsonInvalid: The JSON cannot be read as an eval
editor.changedBody: It is not the file you opened (a pull or another editor changed it). Reload it and lose your edits, or overwrite it with yours.
editor.discardBody: Leaving drops what you changed in this eval.
editor.title: Title
editor.english: Prompts, titles and notes are written in English. A person's own words stay as written.

name.pattern: Lower case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.
name.taken: An eval with this name already exists.

editor.userScope: A user file is measured as it is: it cannot be pinned or proposed.
editor.runAsNote: A team member runs under the flow's own rules for the stage, as it does on the board.
editor.pinHint: A full 40-character SHA: a branch name would move.
editor.samplesHint: Two or more tell a flaky case from a failing one.
editor.ceilingHint: The start dialog may lower it, never raise it.
editor.setupWarn: Runs this repository's code on this machine.
editor.policyKept: This eval carries its own tool policy, which is edited in JSON.
editor.casePinHint: Leave empty to use the eval's commit.
editor.saveFirst: Save the eval first: a run uses the file as it is on disk.
editor.kHint: At most the attempts per case. Default {{default}}.
editor.mustHoldHint: A regression guard: the promotion gate reads its pass^k.

waiting.title: Waiting for a usage limit to reset
waiting.until: Nothing spends meanwhile. It continues at {{time}}.
waiting.body: Nothing spends meanwhile. It continues when the limit resets.

notice.capped_one: Stopped at the ceiling; {{count}} attempt not run.
notice.capped_other: Stopped at the ceiling; {{count}} attempts not run.

sample.title: {{case}} · {{variant}} · attempt {{attempt}}
sample.description: The calls Claude made, what the checks found and its final answer.
sample.truncated: Only the first calls are kept; the checks ran on all of them.

why.limit: A usage limit stopped this attempt. It says nothing about the target and is run again from scratch.
why.interrupted: The run was interrupted before this attempt finished.
why.cancelled: The run was cancelled before this attempt finished.
why.skipped: The run stopped at its ceiling before this attempt.
why.infra: Something outside the target failed (the CLI, the worktree or the setup), so the attempt says nothing about it.
why.unjudged: A judge failed (an error, a limit or an unreadable answer), so a judged expectation has no verdict. It is not scored, and the gate treats it as missing.

history.title: Runs
history.empty: This eval has not run yet.
history.pickTwo_one: Pick two runs to compare. {{count}} picked.
history.pickTwo_other: Pick two runs to compare. {{count}} picked.
history.compareCaption: Cases of two runs on the {{variant}} variant
history.noShared: These runs share no variant, so their cases cannot be set side by side.
history.differ: These runs are less comparable than they look

differs.definition: The eval file changed between them.
differs.cli: They ran on different CLI versions.

start.title: Run “{{title}}”
start.notReady: The estimate is not ready yet.

variantHint.pinned: The target as it was at the eval's commit.
variantHint.current: The target as it is in the checkout now, saved or not.
variantHint.proposed: Text you write or paste here. It is never saved to a file.

start.userScopeHint: A file in your user folder is measured as it is.
start.proposedFromMember: This is the unsaved text from the member's page.
start.proposedSame: The proposed text is the current file, so only one of them runs.
start.proposedEmpty: Write or paste the text to try.
start.accountHint: A pinned account waits at its limit instead of switching.

warning.dirty-checkout: The checkout has uncommitted changes. Only the target's current text is used; other uncommitted changes are not in the eval.
warning.large-checkout: The repository is large, so preparing each worktree takes longer.
warning.target-absent: The target file does not exist in one of the variants, which then runs with no file.
warning.models-differ: The variants will run on different models.
warning.user-scope: This run reads the target from your user folder.
warning.pin-behind-head: The pinned commit is behind HEAD. It still runs on the pin.

consent.title: Review what this eval runs
consent.body: This file may have been written by someone else. Nothing runs until you accept what is below.
consent.accept: I understand these run on this machine

pin-missing.title: The pinned commit is missing
pin-missing.fix: It may have been garbage-collected or the history rewritten. Open the eval and pin to HEAD.

target-missing.title: The target file does not exist
target-missing.fix: The agent this eval runs as has no file. Open the eval and fix the target.

not-git.title: This project is not a git repository
not-git.fix: An eval runs on a pinned commit. Turn the folder into a repository first.

no-commit.title: There is no commit to run on
no-commit.fix: Make a first commit in this repository.

lanes-root-contaminated.title: A CLAUDE.md sits above the worktrees folder
lanes-root-contaminated.fix: It would leak into every variant. Move or remove it: {{detail}}

user-scope-proposal.title: A user file cannot be proposed
user-scope-proposal.fix: A proposal is never written to your user folder. Untick the proposed text.

eval-running.title: An eval is already running in this project
eval-running.fix: Wait for it to end, or cancel it, then start this one.

cost-not-confirmed.title: The ceiling changed
cost-not-confirmed.fix: The estimate was refreshed. Check the new ceiling and run again.

consent-needed.title: The file changed since you reviewed it
consent-needed.fix: The estimate was refreshed. Review what it runs and accept again.

team-off.title: The Team module is off
team-off.fix: Switch it on in the project's settings to use evals.

pressureHint.supportive: Prompts that remind the agent of the rule
pressureHint.competing: Prompts that give a reason to skip the rule

member.needsChange: Change the agent file first: an eval compares a change.
member.tooLarge: The file is too large to hand to an eval (256 KiB at most).

hint.supportive: Reminds the agent of the rule. Written by you; up to {{max}} characters.
hint.neutral: The task alone, sent as the attempt's only message, up to {{max}} characters.
hint.competing: The task plus a plausible reason to skip the rule, such as urgency. Written by you; up to {{max}} characters.

draft.title: Draft cases
draft.note: The project assistant reads the target file and proposes up to five cases, with prompts at each pressure level. Nothing is written until you accept a case.
draft.commands_one: This case runs {{count}} command. Adding it changes the file, so you will be asked for consent again.
draft.commands_other: This case runs {{count}} commands. Adding it changes the file, so you will be asked for consent again.
draft.saveFirst: Save the eval to draft cases for it.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.note: Rates are shown with the number of attempts and a 95% interval: with few attempts the interval is wide.
metrics.caption: Pass rate per case and variant at the {{pressure}} level
metrics.empty: No attempt was scored at this level.
metrics.dropNote: How much the pass rate falls from supportive to competing: how much pressure it takes to break the rule.

gate.title: Promotion gate

explain.promotable: No must-hold case fell and the mean pass rate did not fall by more than its interval. Nothing is applied: you decide.
explain.regressed: A must-hold case fell, or the mean pass rate fell by more than its interval. Nothing is applied.
explain.incomplete: Some attempts could not be scored, so the gate does not say it may be promoted.

reason.unjudged: a judge failed, so the attempt is not scored
reason.judge-unreliable: its judge disagreed with the calibration examples

unreliable.title: Judge unreliable
unreliable.body: A judge disagreed with its calibration examples. The gate stays incomplete until you accept it or edit the statement.

gate.meanBar: Proposed mean {{rate}} against the current interval {{range}}
gate.saveFailed: Could not hand over the proposed text

trend.title: Pass rate over time
trend.few: Two scored runs are needed to draw a trend.
trend.aria: Pass rate over {{count}} runs, the latest {{rate}}
